name: DockDoor
title: DockDoor: free HyperDock alternative
caption:
HyperDock costs $9.95. DockDoor gives your Mac Dock window previews for free 🪟

✅ Hover any Dock icon to see all its windows as live previews
✅ Close, minimize or quit right from the preview
✅ Alt+Tab switcher that shows every window, with search
✅ No analytics, no tracking, nothing leaves your Mac

💻 Mac · macOS 13 or later · Apple silicon + Intel
ℹ️ Needs Accessibility and Screen Recording permission to see your windows. The free app has no paywall

dm_pitch: DockDoor, the free open-source Dock window previews for Mac 🪟

beats.say: Windows has had window previews for years. Mac users pay ten bucks for them.
HyperDock charges nine ninety five. DockDoor costs nothing.
Hover any app in your Dock, and you see all its windows, live.
Hold Option Tab, and it switches between every window, not just apps.
Close, minimize, or quit, right from the preview.
It's the Windows taskbar trick, built into your Mac, for free.
Comment Dock, and I'll send you the link.
